name: Cover Two Defaulters 1
definition: Identifies the two largest assumed defaulting entities under a particular scenario.

Cover1Identification.name: Cover 1 Identification
Cover1Identification.definition: Identifies the member whose default would generate the largest liquidity exposure for the CCP under the scenario and for the relevant currency.

Cover2Identification.name: Cover 2 Identification
Cover2Identification.definition: Identifies the member whose default would generate the second largest liquidity exposure for the CCP under the scenario and for the relevant currency.
